name: Minaret and Archaeological Remains of Jam
description: Rising about 65 metres from a deep river valley in Afghanistan's remote Ghor province, the Minaret of Jam is a slender brick tower built around 1190. Its surface is wrapped in bands of geometric patterns and calligraphy, topped by a blue tile inscription. Ringed by steep mountains, it is a startling sight, though erosion keeps it on the endangered list.
